purpose: Identify the preferred or greater item relative to another.
keywords: A + より + B + のほうが + adjective.
The train is faster than the bus.
formation: A + より + B + のほうが + adjective.
restrictions: The item before のほうが has the stated property to a greater degree.
mistake: Do not reverse the reference item and selected item.
